stories.title: Houthi missiles hit Aden presidential palace, killing five
stories.summary: Houthis fired missiles and drones at Aden's Al-Maashiq presidential palace complex, seat of Yemen's Saudi-backed government, killing five and wounding 16 (Yemeni health minister). The PM and cabinet were safe. It is the first strike on the palace in the current Houthi-Saudi conflict. The coalition said Houthis made 20 attacks on Riyadh's King Khalid airport this month (17 killed, 333 wounded); ICAO's council condemned attacks on Saudi civil aviation.

analysis.text: Hitting the government seat signals the Houthis will widen the war beyond Saudi territory to the Yemeni government itself, raising pressure on the Mokha/Bab el-Mandeb front and on Riyadh to escalate or negotiate.

stories.title: Record Russian drone barrage hits Kirovohrad region during 'energy truce'
stories.unplaced: Governor reported 26 locations across Kirovohrad region; no single site named.
stories.summary: Kirovohrad region suffered its largest Russian attack of the war overnight: 360+ drones hit 26 locations, killing three and wounding six (Gov. Andriy Raikovych). Ukraine's air force said 580 drones were launched nationwide, 536 shot down.

analysis.text: Strikes of this scale on infrastructure are the stated reason Kyiv abandoned the energy pause; expect tit-for-tat refinery and grid strikes to resume at pace.
